name: Cancel reservations
summary: Cancel all waypoint reservations for the specified unit while retaining active attacks, guidance and jamming.
requirements: Requires own-unit information and a unit accepting player orders. Available during an attack or formation following; does not change other units.
execution_note: Removes all waypoint reservations, including movement, sonobuoy drops, formation return and loops. Active attacks, guidance and jamming remain. Already launched weapons and deployed sonobuoys are not undone.
